title: Cliff's Notes for Catcher in the Rye by Richard Prince

description.main: Eric Doeringer's Cliff's Notes-style study guide to Richard Prince's 2011 appropriation of The Catcher in the Rye, with chapter summaries, character sketches and study questions. Photocopied, staple-bound, 58 pages, Copycat Publications, 2018.
description.extended:
Eric Doeringer's study guide to Richard Prince's The Catcher in the Rye, made up as a Cliff's Notes booklet with "Prince" printed where Salinger's name would be.

In 2011 Prince issued an almost exact facsimile of the first edition of J.D. Salinger's novel, changing only the author's name, the retail price and the imprint, and sold shrink-wrapped copies at Central Park. Doeringer's Notes treat that book as Prince's own novel. They supply chapter summaries and commentaries, character sketches and study questions, and repeat the Cliff's Notes warning that a study guide is no substitute for the text. The cover copies the yellow-and-black striped Cliff's Notes design down to the Lincoln, Nebraska imprint. The booklet is photocopied in black and white and stapled, 58 pages, published by Copycat Publications in New York in 2018.

Doeringer (b. 1974) sells "bootleg" copies of other artists' work and reissues artists' books under his Copycat Publications imprint. The library also holds his 121 Nurses (2023), built from the paperbacks behind Prince's Nurse Paintings, and Records (2011), his remake of Ed Ruscha's 1971 book.

notes: Copycat Publications is Eric Doeringer's own imprint (Printed Matter lists publisher as E. Doeringer, Copycat Publications, New York). Photocopy, black-and-white, staple bound, 58 p., 21 x 14.5 cm, 2018, per Printed Matter (catalog 50200). No ISBN. Edition size not stated. Prince context: Center for Book Arts (2011 facsimile altering only authorship, retail price and imprint; shrink-wrapped copies sold at Central Park). Edition of Prince's book given as 500 (Dashwood Books) and 300 (Center for Book Arts), so not stated in the description. Cover is Printed Matter's 394x600 scan, the only image offered. Etsy listing 588925797 (richard-prince-catcher-in-the-rye-notes), supplied by the owner, returned 403 and could not be read.
